question: In Section 4.1.1.2.1, how is a stakeholder defined?

message.content: {"status":"answered","claims":[{"text":"A stakeholder is defined as a group or individual that is affected by or has a stake in the product or project. The key players for a project/product are called the key stakeholders. One key stakeholder is always the customer, who may vary depending on where the systems engineer is working in the Product Breakdown Structure (PBS). The customer and users of the system are usually easy to identify, while other key stakeholders may be more difficult to identify and may change depending on the type of project and the phase the project is in. Other interested parties include those who affect the project by providing broad, overarching constraints within which the customers' needs should be achieved, such as Congress, advisory planning teams, program managers, maintainers, and mission partners. It is important that the list of stakeholders be identified early in the process, as well as the primary stakeholders who will have the most significant influence over the project.","citations":[{"page":45,"bbox":[0.05,0.15,0.95,0.85],"locator":"Section 4.1.1.2.1 Identify Stakeholders"}]}]}

claims.text: A stakeholder is defined as a group or individual that is affected by or has a stake in the product or project. The key players for a project/product are called the key stakeholders. One key stakeholder is always the customer, who may vary depending on where the systems engineer is working in the Product Breakdown Structure (PBS). The customer and users of the system are usually easy to identify, while other key stakeholders may be more difficult to identify and may change depending on the type of project and the phase the project is in. Other interested parties include those who affect the project by providing broad, overarching constraints within which the customers' needs should be achieved, such as Congress, advisory planning teams, program managers, maintainers, and mission partners. It is important that the list of stakeholders be identified early in the process, as well as the primary stakeholders who will have the most significant influence over the project.
